King’s Rising Dallas: 7/20/19
2R+F. 10pl.

Nocturnal Badr
Andy Smith
1t5v/3vpf

First sanctioned event for the Dallas crew in many years! Huge thanks to the PoD Adrian Ruiz for organizing, he sat out so there wouldn’t be the dreaded 11 players. Huzzah. Thanks to everybody who showed up, it was a lot of fun. \m/

I built this specifically for the tournament but it’s nothing new. I anticipated OK but could’ve used more/better vote defense. If I did anything right on the day it was be really patient.
